# Memory index

The one map of what the AIOS remembers. One home per fact; link it here.

- [[Home]]: what this vault is
- Daily notes: `daily/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md` (EOD results, the COG report, decisions of the day)
- Decisions: `decisions/` (every yes Chris gave, with the date)
- Reps: `reps/<Name>.md` (each rep's EOD and compliance history)
- People: `people/` (business contacts by first name)
- Weekly: `weekly/` (the Friday wrap)
